title: Anti Drain
description: A plugin that prevents players from draining freshly placed water sources belonging to other players.
body:
## Features

- Protects water sources placed from:
  - Water Buckets
  - Cod Buckets
  - Salmon Buckets
  - Pufferfish Buckets
  - Tropical Fish Buckets
  - Axolotl Buckets
  - Tadpole Buckets
- The player who placed the water can always pick it back up.
- Other players cannot pick up the source block for 60 seconds.
- Protection automatically expires after 60 seconds.
- Lightweight and memory-efficient.

**During the protection period:**

- ✅ The owner may pick the water back up immediately.
- ❌ Other players cannot pick it up with a bucket.

After 60 seconds:

- ✅ Anyone may pick up the water source.
